hypothesis: Limited view coverage does not create an explicit empty-pixel loss outside the image, but legacy evidence/visibility EMA decays with zeros whenever a Gaussian is outside the sampled view while global support sparsity remains active. This converts missing positive evidence into an implicit negative prior and can produce view-dependent alternating support footprints.

variants.observation_control: legacy EMA and global support losses
variants.ema_only: do not decay evidence/visibility EMA for projections outside the image
variants.support_only: weight support sparsity and entropy by observation confidence, floor 0.05
variants.combined_margin0: observation-aware EMA plus weighted support, zero-pixel margin
variants.combined_margin2: combined mechanism with a 2-pixel trusted-FOV margin
variants.combined_margin4: combined mechanism with a 4-pixel trusted-FOV margin matching kernel radius

fixed: Complete K4 preset, 240 training views, seed 42, 12k, four stages, offset-SDF gradient blend 0.50, asymmetric split displacement 0.20 and shrink 0.80, all other v8-control geometry settings unchanged.
